# Austrian Post subsidiary euShipments.com acquires Slovakian fulfillment provider FHB Group

By Alex Pack August 10, 2026 2 Mins Read

 The acquisition adds two fulfillment sites near Bratislava and expands euShipments.com's network to 27 countries, as Austrian Post Group grows its CEE/SEE logistics footprint 

euShipments.com, in which Austrian Post owns a 70% stake, has acquired 100% of Slovakian fulfillment provider FHB Group, effective August 10. The parties have agreed not to disclose the purchase price.

FHB Group will be fully integrated into the euShipments.com network, and the Slovakian company’s existing management team will remain in place following the acquisition. euShipments.com is already established in Slovakia through its subsidiary euShipments Slovakia, and the deal expands its position as a logistics partner for online retailers in the region.

results.author: FLEX. Logistik Deutschland
results.text:
# Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte. · 2026-09-02T00:00:00+00:00

Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte.

Am 1. September eröffnet unser neuer Standort in Lotte. Damit liegt jetzt die Hälfte unseres gesamten FLEX. Lagernetzwerks in Deutschland.

OSN3 ergänzt WIL1 in Wilhelmshaven und MAG2 in Hermsdorf. Drei Standorte, die unterschiedliche Teile derselben Aufgabe abdecken: Ware näher an den richtigen Markt bringen, Übergaben sauber halten und Verkäufern mehr Spielraum geben, wenn sich Volumen oder Vertriebskanäle verändern.

Und Deutschland ist nur ein Teil des Bildes. FLEX. betreibt inzwischen sechs Lagerstandorte in Deutschland, Frankreich, Polen und Großbritannien.

Für uns ist OSN3 deshalb mehr als eine neue Adresse in Lotte. Es ist ein weiterer Baustein in einem Netzwerk, das europäische Fulfilment weniger fragmentiert machen soll.

Willkommen im Netzwerk, OSN3. ❤️

#FLEXlogistik #EcommerceLogistik #Lagerlogistik #CrossBorderLogistics

EuShipments.com has acquired 100% of Slovakian fulfilment provider FHB Group to improve technology-based fulfilment in Slovakia.

FHB Group is a major fulfillment provider in Slovakia and the region, offering eCommerce logistics solutions – storage & order fulfillment, cross-border delivery, returns management and COD solution.

Post AG: Effiziente Versandlösung für KMU: euShipments.com vereinfacht europaweite Logistik mit zentralem Fulfillment in Österreich.

 Geneva10

Mayor and Kenosha County Executive to join company and community leaders in marking the milestone expansion

KENOSHA, Wis., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- G10 Fulfillment, a North American third-party logistics and fulfillment provider, will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony celebrating the grand opening of its new distribution facility in Kenosha, Wisconsin, on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at 12345 38th Street.

The new 315,000-square-foot facility replaces G10's former Twin Lakes location and more than doubles the company's Midwest warehouse capacity. Positioned along the Chicago–Milwaukee freight corridor, the site supports large-scale order fulfillment and regional inventory distribution as part of G10's broader logistics network.

BY Our Correspondent 16 Oct 2026 3:03 PM IST

Just in time for the most demanding retail period of the year, Edgistify, a leading supply chain and fulfilment provider for over 70 consumer brands, has officially expanded its physical infrastructure in North India. On 16 October 2026, the company announced the launch of a new 68,000 sq ft Grade A warehouse located within the IndoSpace logistics park at Luhari, Haryana.

This significant addition marks the company’s third high-grade fulfilment centre in the crucial Gurugram region. According to corporate representatives, the facility is already fully operational, with both new and existing customers actively shipping commercial orders from the site.

# Walmart Opens Next-Generation Fulfillment Center in Stockton, Expanding Faster Delivery Across the West Coast

Oct. 8, 2026

 

## New facility will create 1,000+ jobs and use advanced automation and technology to increase fulfillment capacity

STOCKTON, Calif., Oct. 8, 2026 — Walmart today opened its fifth next-generation fulfillment center, a more than 900,000-square-foot facility in Stockton that will create more than 1,000 jobs and expand the retailer’s ability to provide faster shipping and delivery to customers across California and the West Coast.

The new facility represents the latest step in Walmart’s transformation of its supply chain, bringing associates together with advanced automation, technology and machine learning to move products faster and more efficiently. The technology enables Walmart to materially improve storage capacity and increase the number of customer orders the facility can fulfill each day compared with a traditional fulfillment center.
